headline: Former Spanish Central Bank Chief Pablo Hernandez de Cos Picked as Next ECB President
summary: Euro zone countries selected Pablo Hernandez de Cos to succeed Christine Lagarde as European Central Bank President, aiming for policy continuity at the financial institution.
why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the 20 countries sharing the euro, making its leadership crucial for eurozone interest rates, inflation management, and currency stability.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: ECB leadership transitions can influence monetary policy expectations and currency valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The nomination of a veteran central banker signals policy continuity, affecting expectations around future interest rate paths and currency valuations.
